title: Body word list (words only) and wudu sentences
subject: Arabic
unit: Summer 1: Common vocabulary: prepositions, questions and body parts
source: Seeded from arabic/y7 lesson 30 (Pupil PDF worksheet: body word list (words only) and wudu sentences)
intro: Lesson 30: Parts of the body (1): the head and face. To understand and use Arabic words for parts of the head and face, with dual forms

questions.model: Teacher: one ear is أُذُن. For two, add ـَانِ: أُذُنَانِ. Pupils touch both ears and say it.

questions.q: Body word list on the pupil PDF (words only, no pictures of faces): write the seven head and face words with harakat and what each does, for example عَيْن: أَنْظُرُ بِهَا (I see with it); then write three wudu sentences with أَغْسِلُ or أَمْسَحُ.
questions.a: Seven words with correct harakat and uses (أُذُن: أَسْمَعُ بِهَا؛ فَم: آكُلُ بِهِ) and three wudu sentences in order
questions.model: Teacher writes: رَأْس; then the sentence أَمْسَحُ رَأْسِي (I wipe my head).

questions.q: write 'I have two eyes and two ears': لِي عَيْنَانِ وَأُذُنَانِ.
